name: CRL Generator
description: Sign a certificate revocation list with a CA certificate and key, with an explicit revocation reason.

hints.certOnly: Only **certificates** can be revoked here: revoking by serial alone is not supported upstream.
hints.reason7: Reason code 7 is reserved by RFC 5280 and must not be used.
hints.skipVerify: The generated CRL is only signed; use the revocation checker to make a revocation decision.

faq.q: What does the issuer certificate need?
faq.a: It must be a CA certificate carrying a SKID extension — the CRL AKID is taken from it.

faq.q: What is the next update for?
faq.a: A stale CRL cannot serve as revocation evidence; the checker rejects it outright.

faq.q: Can several certificates be revoked at once?
faq.a: The API accepts multiple entries; this page fills in one.
